# LingoCircle

> > LingoCircle offers live online language classes and AI-powered games for children, featuring CEFR-aligned curricula in French, Spanish, English, Chinese, and Arabic with native teachers.

The platform includes Bilingual Bébé, an online preschool program for ages 3-12, combining play-based immersion learning with small group classes. LingoCircle serves bilingual families worldwide with programs aligned to International Baccalaureate standards.

## Key Topics

- CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference)
- Bilingual Bébé online preschool
- Native teacher instruction
- Early childhood language education
- Full immersion methodology
- IB Bilingual Diploma preparation
- AI-powered language games
- Small group virtual classes
- Play-based learning approach
- Multilingual curriculum (French, Spanish, English, Chinese, Arabic)
- International Baccalaureate alignment
- Parent resources for bilingual education
- CEFR proficiency levels

## Language Programs

- [Learn French for Kids | Online French Classes](https://lingocircle.com/fr/home-francais): French homepage for Bilingual Bébé play-based language learning program

- [Learn French for Kids | Online French Classes](https://lingocircle.com/fr/home-6): Bilingual Bébé French immersion program with virtual early childhood classes
- [Learn English](https://lingocircle.com/curriculum/learn-english): English curriculum for children with CEFR-aligned full immersion classes
- [Online Spanish Classes for Kids](https://lingocircle.com/online-spanish-classes-for-kids): CEFR-aligned Spanish classes with native teachers in small groups
- [Online Chinese Classes for Kids - Francais](https://lingocircle.com/fr/online-chinese-classes-for-kids-francais): CEFR-aligned Chinese classes with native teachers for French-speaking families
- [Online Arabic Classes for Kids - Francais](https://lingocircle.com/fr/online-arabic-classes-for-kids-francais): CEFR-aligned Arabic classes with native teachers for French-speaking families
